reference.title: Reference
reference.lead: An engineer's cheat sheet: fits with a tolerance calculator, steel grades, GD&T symbols, surface roughness and welds. Values are typical; always check the standard for exact figures.
reference.fitsLead: ISO 286. Pick a nominal size and tolerance classes and the diagram updates. In notes, write `H7/p6` or `Ø25 H7/p6` to get a tooltip.
reference.steelsLead: Grade, standard, foreign equivalents, strength and typical use. In notes, `40Х` or `Сталь 45` gets a tooltip.
reference.gdtLead: ISO 1101 / ГОСТ 2.308. A tolerance sits in a frame: symbol, value in mm, then datum letters.
reference.frameExample: Examples: perpendicularity 0.02 mm to datum A; position Ø0.1 mm to datums A and B.
reference.roughnessLead: ГОСТ 2789-73 / ISO 21920. Ra in µm is the usual parameter. Old Soviet roughness classes still show up in textbooks, so they are listed too.
reference.weldsLead: ГОСТ 5264-80 (manual arc welding) and ГОСТ 2.312-72 (symbols). A weld code is the joint letter plus the preparation number, e.g. «ГОСТ 5264-80-Т1-⊿6».

tools.title: Tools
tools.lead: Business and project calculators, strategy templates, a Gantt builder, SQL and an Excel cheat sheet. Everything runs in your browser, and what you fill in stays with you.
tools.calcsLead: Move the sliders: numbers and charts update instantly. In a note, a calculator is a `tool` block.
tools.canvasLead: Fill in a template; it is saved in this browser. The PDF button gives a clean sheet to print or send.
tools.ganttLead: Tasks start on a day, on a date or “after 1,2”. Red is the critical path: a delay there moves the whole project.
tools.processLead: Click a step to see what happens there. Funnel steps show the conversion between them.
tools.casesLead: A situation, a few options and the reasoning behind each. A strong decision scores 1, a risky one 0.5.
tools.sqlLead: A practice store database: customers, products, orders. Write any SELECT, JOIN or GROUP BY; the database is rebuilt on every run.
tools.excelLead: The functions you need most in finance and analytics: Russian and English names, syntax and an example.
